text:
tara: Vendor uploaded PT-900 to our bucket. Quick summary: staging KMS key grants `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/runner-ephemeral` Decrypt, Dedicated hosts lack SSM session transcripts, and API logs redact bodies. Need triage + mitigation + retest checklist.
ben: drop the S3 path?
tara: s3://redwood-pt/reports/PT-900/2026-04-05/report.pdf
kai: thanks. which alias is implicated?
tara: alias/redwood/staging-pt900. Policy includes the runner-ephemeral principal.
ben: if that role can decrypt staging secrets, vendor could pull configs or snapshots. Immediate mitigation for staging: create replacement CMK, point new alias, remove principal from old key policy, re-encrypt state/secrets. Hot-swap ok with canary.
kai: terraform backend note: if tfstate uses the same key we'll need to re-encrypt or migrate the backend. I'll prepare `terraform init -reconfigure` and `aws kms re-encrypt` steps.
sec-bot: Ticket PT-900-REMED created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-900-REMED :page_with_curl:
oncall: I can page SRE for an after-hours window. Propose 02:15-03:30 UTC.
tara: logging gaps from report: (1) Dedicated hosts: Session Manager start events exist but no transcript objects; (2) API: request bodies are redacted which prevents replay. Report recommends enabling session transcripts to an encrypted S3 bucket and storing security-flagged request bodies in a restricted archive for 60 days.
ben: owners: KMS+tfstate -> kai. SSM transcripts -> ben. API body archival -> tara. Everyone ok with tonight 02:15-03:30?
kai: I can own 02:15-03:15 for key rotation and tfstate migration. Runbook outline I'll add to the ticket.
ben: I'll flip SSM transcript target and validate with a dummy session. Runbook snippet: `aws ssm start-session --target i-0abc123def --document-name AWS-StartInteractiveCommand` then check s3://redwood-pt/ssm-transcripts/sessions/{instance}/{ts}.
tara: for API bodies we'll create s3://redwood-sec/pt900-bodies with KMS encryption and strict bucket policy. We'll route flagged requests to that stream and run a scrubber to remove PII.
sec-bot: Evidence folder created: s3://redwood-pt/evidence/PT-900/ (ACL: eng-security only)
kai: minimal policy diff we'll add: `- \"Principal\": {\"AWS\": \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/runner-ephemeral\"} + /* removed runner-ephemeral principal */`
ben: also collect CloudTrail lookup of prior decrypt calls against the old key: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:...:key/...` and stash output in evidence.
tara: retest ask to vendor: 1) attempt the reported escalation in staging (timeboxed) 2) validate SSM transcripts capture commands and are accessible only to eng-security 3) replay archived API bodies to confirm no tampering vector. Proposed retest window tomorrow 09:30-11:00 UTC.
kai: I'll post exact terraform + aws commands in the runbook before the window and include a rollback alias script.
oncall: I'll be on standby for the window. If anything breaks abort and invoke rollback runbook.
tara: thanks team  drop short status updates here during the operation. :white_check_mark:
